observations.title: Waiver of Sanctions on Syria Under the Chemical and Biological Weapons Control and Warfare Elimination Act of 1991
entities: Government of the Syrian Arab Republic
Under Secretary for Arms Control and Nonproliferation
observations.summary: Two sequential waiver actions lifted CBW Act sanctions on Syria. First, on June 30, 2025, the President determined there had been a fundamental change in the leadership and policies of the Government of the Syrian Arab Republic and waived all CBW Act sanctions imposed on Syria stemming from the Assad regime's use of chemical weapons — except the restrictions on arms sales and arms sales financing, which were explicitly retained. Second, on August 20, 2026, the Under Secretary for Arms Control and Nonproliferation determined it was essential to U.S. national security to waive those two remaining restrictions (arms sales and arms sales financing). The notice was published and effective September 16, 2026 (91 FR 58740).

Proposal of Special Measure Prohibiting the Transmittal of Funds Regarding Transactions Involving the A7 Network's Sub-Agents
observations.summary: FinCEN has issued a finding and notice of proposed rulemaking (NPRM) identifying transactions involving any company operating outside the United States that is controlled by the A7 Network as a class of transactions of primary money laundering concern in connection with Russian illicit finance. The A7 Network is characterized as a sanctions evasion and money laundering service with ties to Russia, used by a wide range of illicit actors including Iran and its terrorist proxies. The proposed rule would prohibit covered financial institutions from transmitting funds involving that class of transactions. This is a PROPOSED rule only; no final rule or effective date has been established.
